mainText: Hello, Verona! At 9 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we are seeing overcast skies at City Hall under a Waning Gibbous moon. The ISS passes overhead tonight, but you won't be able to see it due to the clouds. Overnight temperatures will drop to 48 degrees with rain predicted.

The city reminds residents that winter street parking rules start November 20, requiring vehicles to alternate sides of the street between 1 a.m. and 6 a.m. to allow for snow removal. Additionally, the Verona Senior Center will be closed for the Thanksgiving holiday on November 26 and 27.

There is plenty to do, starting with Main Street Trick-Or-Treat today at Hometown Junction Park and Live Music at Bailey's Run today. Tomorrow, you can visit the Dane County Farmer's Market or catch music at Paddy Mac's.
In the weekly police report, officers responded to a call on October 25 where a man was found in his vehicle at an intersection and subsequently arrested for O W I.
Stop by Culver's for the delicious Chocolate Covered Strawberry flavor of the day before they close at 10:30 PM.
